flags.message: Salience version mismatch on every candidate (codex-baseline, claude-baseline, gemini-baseline): each prediction froze context.band=baseline under context.salience_version=sal-v3, but the committed metrics/statpack.md 'Segment base rate by salience band' table is headed sal-v4. Per the evaluate contract the table is no baseline for a sal-v3 band, so segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score are omitted and base_rate_basis left null on all three evaluations; no terminal relabel was applied. Skill for this cell can be scored only against a sal-v3 band table, which the committed pack no longer renders.
